rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (16 tracks) per https://www.spinmagazine.com/2008/04/radiohead-best-release-date-tracklist-revealed/, https://www.bibleinmylanguage.com/radiohead-the-best-of-16-classic-tracks-including-creep-karma-police-paranoid-android-fake-plastic-trees-and-no-surprises-parlophone-audio-cd-2008-216-3052/. Official EMI compilation (Jun 2008), released without the band's input. This is the standard 16-track single-disc edition; 'Idioteque' appears as an edit. The deluxe 2CD edition adds a 13-track second disc: Airbag, I Might Be Wrong, Go to Sleep, Let Down, Planet Telex, Exit Music (For a Film), The National Anthem, Knives Out, Talk Show Host, You, Anyone Can Play Guitar, How to Disappear Completely, True Love Waits (Live).
